title: 第17章 起源庇护所第18章 同心协力
slug: 永恒降临全民开局末世求生
content_zh:
四座建筑的分布为：图书馆在中间，后方是已经倒塌的宿舍楼，前方左侧为食堂，右侧为教学楼，由于图书馆的地基比较高，就算是只有四楼，也跟五楼的宿舍楼一样高。
【你消耗石砖×1、金块×4，制作避雷针，已解锁避雷针，精神值+15。
苏墨既然打算把这里作为庇护所，一些该有的东西还是需要建设一下的，
其余三个人，苏墨打发他们朝不同方向去探图，顺便也加了严梅的联系方式，方便及时支援。
在制作的过程，苏墨查看自己的面板，技能一栏里多了一个。
【投掷精通（lv.1）：精确的投掷，所投掷的物体伤害大量提升。
技能等级分为：入门、基础、精通、大师、宗师。
至于宗师之上，苏墨前世八阶也没有听说过。
剑术由于这几天没有刻意锻炼，没有进步，在「永恒领域」什么都不是一蹴而就的，例如，寻得前辈传承，也是需要自己一步步将等级提升上来。
将避雷针放好位置，防止一道闪电劈下来，就算没劈到人，劈到一些植物，引起火灾的话，想到这里，苏墨知道还要做一个雪球发射器。
【你消耗燧石×1、金块×1，制作指南针。
来到科学二本旁，选择[制作-科技]一栏。
【你消耗指南针×1、木板×4，制作制图桌，已解锁制图桌，精神值+15。
将制图桌放在科学二本的旁边，这样就能够共享地图了，接触到制图桌，就有信息浮现。
【是否将你的地图绘制于制图桌上。
苏墨选择了【是】，原本空白的图纸就出现了苏墨曾经走过的路线，制图桌上的地图只能直接查看，不能点亮自己的地图，需要消耗莎草纸和羽毛笔，才可以点亮没去过的地方。
快黄昏时才看见几人回来，分别将地图共享在制图桌上，又拿出便携锅开始烹饪料理，今天依旧是肉丸大餐。
看着制图桌上面的地图，苏墨判断，庇护所好像挺隐蔽的，周围全是树木，好像处于森林中一样，只是周围没有山。
一口吞下肉丸，赵敢当开口：“苏兄，你说我们一天都吃肉丸会不会营养不均衡啊？”
闻言，苏墨挑了挑眉：“怎么还考虑起营养均衡的问题了？”

“嘿嘿，俺不是想先打好底子，以后方便修炼嘛。”
这几天，苏墨一直给赵敢当传输一些习武的经验，听得赵敢当热血澎湃，对于超凡的道路愈发渴望了。
奇怪？这附近没有传承吗？还是要等到后期自己制作传承点，算了，等以后再说吧。
可惜，物资箱里面没有开出传承书。
苏墨开始想事情了，突然想到一件事，也没有问问赵敢当他们当时是选择公证什么物品的。
“敢当，你当时公证的是什么东西啊？”
苏墨问道。
赵敢当不好意思的挠了挠头，“俺公证的是俺的全家福。”
说完从储物栏中拿出了一张照片，照片中间是一个虎头虎脑的小孩，应该有七八岁的样子，右边的男子看着有些虚弱，难怪赵敢当说他爸走的早，右边是一个膀大腰圆的女人，看着很和善，三人都一脸笑容，看着很幸福的样子。
把照片递还给赵敢当，又被严梅和苏婷借去看了。
“敢当小弟，你小时看起来好可爱啊！”
content_en:
The distribution of the four buildings is: the library is in the middle, the collapsed dormitory building is behind, the cafeteria is on the left in front, and the teaching building is on the right. Since the foundation of the library is relatively high, even if it is only the fourth floor, it is as high as the dormitory building on the fifth floor.
[You consume stone bricks x 1 and gold nuggets x 4 to make a lightning rod. The lightning rod has been unlocked and your mental value is +15.
Since Su Mo plans to use this place as a shelter, some necessary things still need to be built.
Su Mo sent the remaining three people in different directions to explore the map, and also added Yan Mei's contact information to facilitate timely support.
During the production process, Su Mo checked his dashboard and saw an extra skill in the skill column.
[Throwing Mastery (lv.1): Accurate throwing, the damage of thrown objects is greatly increased.
Skill levels are divided into: entry, basic, proficient, master, and grandmaster.
As for those above the Grand Master, Su Mo had never heard of the eighth level in his previous life.
Since swordsmanship has not been practiced deliberately in the past few days, there has been no progress. In the "eternal realm", nothing can be achieved overnight. For example, to find the inheritance of the predecessors, you also need to upgrade your level step by step.
Put the lightning rod in a good position to prevent a bolt of lightning from striking down. Even if it doesn't hit anyone, it could hit some plants and cause a fire. Thinking of this, Su Mo knew he had to make a snowball launcher.
[You consume flint ×1 and gold nugget ×1 to make a compass.
Come to the second science book and select the [Production-Technology] column.
[You consume compass x 1 and wooden board x 4 to make a drafting table. The drafting table has been unlocked, and the spiritual value is +15.
Place the cartography table next to the second science book so that you can share the map. When you touch the cartography table, information will emerge.
[Whether to draw your map on the cartographic table.
Su Mo chose [Yes], and the route that Su Mo had taken appeared on the originally blank drawing. The map on the drawing table could only be viewed directly, and you could not light up your own map. You need to consume papyrus and quill pens to light up places you have never been to.
It was almost dusk when I saw a few people coming back. They shared the maps on the cartography table, and took out the portable pots to start cooking. Today was still a meatball feast.
Looking at the map on the drafting table, Su Mo judged that the shelter seemed quite hidden. It was surrounded by trees, as if it were in a forest, but there were no mountains around it.
After swallowing the meatballs in one bite, Zhao Gandang said: "Brother Su, do you think it will be nutritionally unbalanced if we eat meatballs all day long?"
Hearing this, Su Mo raised his eyebrows: "Why are you still thinking about nutritional balance?"
"Hey, I don't want to lay a solid foundation first so that I can practice more easily later."
In the past few days, Su Mo has been imparting some martial arts experience to Zhao Gandang. Hearing Zhao Gandang's enthusiasm, Zhao Gandang became more and more eager for the extraordinary path.
strangeness? Is there no heritage around here? We still have to wait until later to make inheritance points ourselves. Forget it, let’s talk about it later.
Unfortunately, there was no inheritance book in the supply box.
Su Mo started to think about something, and suddenly thought of something. He didn't ask Zhao Gandang what items they chose to notarize at that time.
"Dare to be honest, what was it that you notarized at that time?"
Su Mo asked.
Zhao Gandang scratched his head in embarrassment, "What I am notarizing is my family portrait."
After that, he took out a photo from the storage column. In the middle of the photo was a sturdy-looking child, who should be about seven or eight years old. The man on the right looked a little weak. No wonder Zhao Gandang said that his father left early. On the right was a tall and round woman who looked very kind. All three of them had smiles on their faces and looked very happy.
He handed the photo back to Zhao Gandang, and it was borrowed by Yan Mei and Su Ting to look at.
"Dare to be my little brother, you looked so cute when you were little!"
